children: Zoned Properties completed its sale of substantially all of its business and assets to BPB Partners for a $7.8 million purchase price, reduced by debt assumed by the buyer. At closing, the company also redeemed all 2 million outstanding preferred shares for an aggregate $2 million, paying $1 million each to Gregory Johnston and McLaren Family LLLP. BPB Partners is owned by company executives, and the sale was approved by an independent-director committee and company stockholders.
